description:
Here we are again, remaking a Ben & Jerry's. This time it's Dirt Cake Topped and it is DELICIOUS and not very difficult to make either. 

What you'll need:
370g Milk
370 Cream
26g Sugar
90g Invert Sugar / Corn Syrup
10g Vanilla Extract (optional as it's got enough vanilla flavour already)
56g Skim Milk Powder
84g Jell-o Vanilla Pudding Mix

1 Pack (270g) of Original Oreos
100g of Milk Chocolate for the top
10g Refined Coconut Oil (no coconut flavour or smell)

If you like "Topped" Ben & Jerry's ice cream, why not check out this one:
https://youtu.be/KaosgB5kA70?si=T4Z6Q-RGJ9yw7wXH

--------------------

If you like Ben & Jerry's Marshmallow Sky, check this out ;) :
